mechanism.claim: Volatile BTC alternates between short-horizon trend propagation and reversal. A causal change in the best recently realized formulaic expert is a regime transition rather than a persistent level. Trade only the first four-hour boundary at which the winning 4h/12h momentum-or-reversal expert changes, using the new winner for eight hours.
mechanism.side: side emitted by the new highest mean gross-log-payoff expert
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDOER trades every high-volatility daily level of a 6h/24h expert winner and failed clock novelty. HVOER uses 4h/12h experts, four-hour matured labels, and emits only winner-transition events. It reuses no HVDOER clock, event, control, or threshold and is not a shifted daily policy.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: current completed eight-hour variation must rank in its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse offset winner-change events are not fixed Gross9 calendars

returns.r4: log(last completed close/completed close exactly 4h earlier)
returns.r12: log(last completed close/completed close exactly 12h earlier)

features.counterfactual_label: expert side at prior decision times times log(open at prior entry+8h/open at prior entry); label matures only when exit open is observed
features.online_score: arithmetic mean gross log payoff before costs over latest at most 60 mature labels, minimum 30; largest wins and frozen expert order breaks exact ties
features.rotation: current winner differs from immediately prior consecutive source-valid decision winner; missing prior cannot trigger
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared 96 exact completed 5m close-to-close returns over prior 8h)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

causal_label_authorization.allowed: only fixed expert labels whose exit open is observed at or before current decision

clock.reservation: winner changes inside an active half-open position are suppressed, not queued
clock.funding: not signal input; exact held settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.winner_level: every source-valid winner level; diagnostic only
definitions.one_decision_stale_winner: prior winner side on primary clock

source_plan.live_extension: read-only Postgres BTCUSDT 1m through 2026-08-01 with overlap parity
source_plan.economic_execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no expert, memory, label, rotation, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
